_readme: Configuration for content-radar. Run 'npx content-radar check' to validate. Unknown keys are reported rather than ignored, because a typo in a rule name would silently disable a gate you believe is running.

brand.positioning: One line. Goes into the brief so a drafting step knows who is speaking.

vocabulary._readme: banned words fail the run wherever they appear. bannedPhrases are [pattern, label] pairs, matched case-insensitively. spelling is 'en-GB', 'en-US' or null.
